sample_unit: source files of pediatric patient instructions

links.outcome: Translation quality (MQM score) of GPT-4o versus professional human translators on the same instructions
links.effect: Mean difference 1.6 MQM points (90% CI, 0.7-2.5), within equivalence margin of ±5; LLM had fewer mistranslation errors; 52% (SE 6%) of ratings preferred the LLM.
links.quote: Equivalence testing showed no significant difference in translation quality between GPT-4o and human translations, with a mean difference of 1.6 points (90% CI, 0.7-2.5), falling within a predefined equivalence margin of plus or minus 5 MQM points.

unlisted_practices: Equivalence testing of LLM translations against professional human translations using the MQM framework with independent professional medical translator raters

screen.reason: Empirical evaluation of GPT-4o translation of patient instructions compared to professional human translators using retrospective clinical encounter texts, assessing model performance alone without testing an organizational deployment safeguard/practice.
